summary: Project involves an admin panel; user reports admin panel access/loading issue for traviscastonguay@gmail.com and requests an 'Owner' admin indicator with the owner email locked/non-editable.
known_issues: Admin panel does not load / user cannot access panel when logged in as traviscastonguay@gmail.com.

existing_features.title: Fix the admin route infinite loading state by handling the case where the authenticated user is signed in but the backend actor is not available (or admin check cannot run). Update the admin-gating UI to show a clear error state with a retry action instead of spinning forever.
Add an Owner indicator in the admin UI that displays the email "traviscastonguay@gmail.com" with a lock icon and the label "Owner", and ensure it cannot be edited from the UI.

new_feature_requests.summary: In admin settings, show traviscastonguay@gmail.com as Owner with a lock indicator and prevent editing that owner email.

Ensure the owner account associated with the email "traviscastonguay@gmail.com" can successfully gain admin access so the admin panel loads. Implement a backend owner bootstrap mechanism that can grant admin privileges to the principal that proves ownership by having a saved user profile email matching "traviscastonguay@gmail.com".

projectName: Fix admin panel access/loading for owner account and show locked Owner email in admin UI
